analysis.title: ASM International (ASMI.AS): 3Q26 First Take: Advanced Logic momentum drives FY27 upgrade, with an expanding 1.4nm opportunity
key_insights: ASMI 3Q26 revenue of €1,159mn was 5% above company-compiled consensus (€1,109mn), up 16% sequentially and 45% y/y. Reported EBIT of €379mn was 4% above consensus (€364mn).
Gross margin was 52.0% vs company-compiled consensus of 51.2%, reflecting favourable mix effects and cost efficiency measures.
Advanced Logic/Foundry was the primary growth driver in 3Q26, supported by continued 2nm investment, strong HBM-related DRAM demand and solid mature Logic/Foundry sales in China.
4Q26 revenue guidance is €1,230mn at the mid-point in constant currency, 3% ahead of Visible Alpha consensus. It implies 35% y/y growth in FY26 vs 32% in Visible Alpha consensus.

FY27 revenue outlook was raised to >€5.7bn in constant currency from €3.7-4.6bn previously. This is 4% above company-compiled consensus of c.€5.5bn and reaches the 2030 revenue target from the 2025 investor day three years early.

Management attributed the FY27 upgrade mainly to advanced Logic/Foundry, where continued 2nm investment and the 1.4nm ramp should drive 2027 growth. Memory is also expected to grow robustly, Power/Analog/Wafer should recover, and mature Logic/Foundry should stay relatively stable.

ASMI cited a double-digit increase in its served available market at 1.4nm vs 2nm, plus market share gains. The node made a solid contribution in 3Q26 and is expected to be an increasingly important growth driver in 2027.

ASMI launched the XP8 Vertos Flowable Carbon platform, its entry into a new PECVD patterning application. The platform is already deployed in high-volume manufacturing and broadens the addressable market beyond core ALD and Epi.
The Board authorised a new share buyback programme of up to €300mn.

GS expects an initial positive share price reaction to the above-consensus 4Q26 and FY27 guide and the buyback. The stock has underperformed broader EU Tech by 14% over 1M and 17% over 3M, but is up 44% absolute YTD.
GS reiterates Buy with a 12-month price target of €955 (20x 2HCY27+1HCY28E EV/EBITDA), 28.5% upside from €743.20.

GS lists five investor questions: visibility behind the >€5.7bn FY27 outlook, 1.4nm customer ramp timing, order intake cadence (especially leading-edge Logic/Foundry), tool supply capacity and bottlenecks, and 2026 gross margin cadence.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 beat, 4Q26 guide and FY27 outlook above consensus, and a growing 1.4nm opportunity. GS expects an initial positive share price reaction.

sector_views.rationale: Advanced Logic/Foundry 2nm and 1.4nm investment, HBM-related DRAM demand and a Power/Analog/Wafer recovery support ASMI's FY27 revenue outlook.

earnings_insights: ASMI 3Q26 reported revenue €1,159mn vs company-compiled consensus €1,109mn (+5%), reported 10/28. Up 16% q/q and 45% y/y.
ASMI 3Q26 reported gross profit €603mn vs consensus €568mn (+6%). Gross margin 52.0% vs consensus 51.2%.
ASMI 3Q26 reported operating income (EBIT) €379mn vs consensus €364mn (+4%). EBIT margin 32.7% vs consensus 32.8%.
ASMI 3Q26 reported net earnings €308mn vs consensus €305mn (+1%). Order intake was €1,081mn.
4Q26 revenue guidance is €1,230mn at the mid-point in constant currency, 3% above Visible Alpha consensus. It implies 35% y/y FY26 growth vs 32% in Visible Alpha consensus.

FY27 revenue outlook is >€5.7bn in constant currency (previously €3.7-4.6bn), 4% above company-compiled consensus of c.€5.5bn. GS estimates FY27E revenue of €5,318mn, EBIT of €1,681mn and EPS of €28.41.
GS FY26E estimates: revenue €4,142mn, EBIT €1,283mn, EPS €22.31. GS quarterly EPS estimates: €5.67 for 9/26E, €5.97 for 12/26E and €6.34 for 3/27E.
risk_factors: Tool supply capacity constraints and potential bottlenecks, flagged as an investor question.
vol_and_positioning: ASMI has underperformed broader EU Tech by 14% over the last month and 17% over three months, but is up 44% absolute YTD.
geopolitical: Solid mature Logic/Foundry sales in China are cited as a contributor to 3Q26 results.
